item.title: On the streets of Cortina d’Ampezzo, the Olympic spirit is in everyone
item.description: This Olympic spirit floods Cortina d'Ampezzo, from the athletes to their fans to the police. For these two weeks, at least, the love of the Games is the great equalizer. The post On the streets of Cortina d’Ampezzo, the Olympic spirit is in everyone appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Park City mogulists Nick Page and Charlie Mickel finish in seventh, 12th place in Olympic moguls
item.description: Page, in his second Games, posted a finals two score of 75. He was in podium position for a few minutes, before the final few skiers knocked him off. Mickel, making his games debut, finished with a 78.03 score in finals one, where only the top eight skiers advanced to the finals. The post Park City mogulists Nick Page and Charlie Mickel finish in seventh, 12th place in Olympic moguls appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Park City mogulists falter in Olympic men’s finals
item.description: Parkite Nick Page was among the world's best, punching his ticket to final two with a score of 80.08, where he finished in seventh place. The post Park City mogulists falter in Olympic men’s finals appeared first on Park Record.

item.title: Utahn Mary Bocock crashes in Olympic debut at super-G, but unhurt and happy
item.description: Seventeen of the 43 starters did not finish, with five of the first nine disqualified after missing gates across multiple sections, making the super-G into a wild game, where anyone could end up on the podium with so much of the field out of contention.
